title: Read the diff
brief: app.txt changed while you were away. Before you commit anything, look at exactly what changed with git diff. If it is the polish you expected, stage and commit it as "polish app".

goals.label: A commit with the message "polish app" exists

hints: git diff shows removed lines in red and added lines in green.
Happy with it? git add app.txt, then git commit -m "polish app".
